parameters.description: Enter a part ID for traceability lookup

queries.text:
OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime, 5m)
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by timestamp = bucket_start, line_id
| invoke OeeKpis()
| project timestamp, line_id, availability = round(Availability, 4), performance = round(Performance, 4),
          quality = round(Quality, 4), oee = round(OEE, 4)
| order by timestamp desc

LineMaster
| project line_id
| join kind=leftouter (
    OeeFacts(ago(5m), now(), 5m)
    | summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by line_id
    | invoke OeeKpis()
) on line_id
| project line_id, oee = round(coalesce(OEE, 0.0) * 100, 1)
| order by line_id asc

let K = OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
    | summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by line_id
    | invoke OeeKpis();
union
    (K | project line_id, metric = "Availability", value = round(Availability * 100, 1)),
    (K | project line_id, metric = "Performance", value = round(Performance * 100, 1)),
    (K | project line_id, metric = "Quality", value = round(Quality * 100, 1))
| order by line_id asc, metric asc

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, machine_status, idle_reason, machine_type, line_id,
    station_position, input_buffer_count, output_buffer_count, current_part_id) by device_id
| project device_id, line_id, station_position, machine_type, machine_status,
    idle_reason, input_buffer_count, output_buffer_count, current_part_id, timestamp
| order by line_id asc, station_position asc

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where machine_status == "Fault"
| summarize fault_count = count() by device_id, machine_type, line_id, station_position
| order by fault_count desc

PartEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where action == "completed"
| lookup kind=inner (LineMaster | project line_id, station_count) on line_id
| where station_position == station_count
| summarize parts_finished = count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), line_id
| order by timestamp desc, line_id asc

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
| where line_id == _lineId
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by station_position, machine_type
| invoke OeeKpis()
| order by station_position asc
| project station = strcat(station_position, " ", machine_type), availability = round(Availability, 4),
          performance = round(Performance, 4), quality = round(Quality, 4), oee = round(OEE, 4)

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, machine_status, idle_reason, machine_type, line_id,
    station_position, input_buffer_count, output_buffer_count, current_part_id) by device_id
| where line_id == _lineId
| project device_id, station_position, machine_type, machine_status,
    idle_reason, input_buffer_count, output_buffer_count, current_part_id, timestamp
| order by station_position asc

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, machine_status, idle_reason, input_buffer_count,
    output_buffer_count, buffer_capacity) by device_id, line_id, station_position, machine_type
| where line_id == _lineId
| where machine_status == "Idle"
| project device_id, station_position, machine_type, idle_reason,
    input_buffer_count, output_buffer_count, buffer_capacity, timestamp
| order by station_position asc

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where line_id == _lineId
| where machine_status == "Running"
| join kind=inner StationMaster
    on $left.line_id == $right.line_id, $left.station_position == $right.station_position
| summarize avg_actual = round(avg(actual_cycle_time), 1), ideal = round(avg(ideal_cycle_time), 1)
    by station_position, machine_type
| project station_position, machine_type, avg_actual, ideal
| order by station_position asc

let created =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where action == "Created"
    | summarize create_time = min(timestamp) by work_order_id, device_id, machine_type,
        line_id, station_position, issue_type;
let resolved =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where action == "Resolved"
    | summarize resolve_time = min(timestamp) by work_order_id;
let techs =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where isnotempty(technician_id)
    | summarize technician_id = any(technician_id) by work_order_id;
created
| join kind=leftouter resolved on work_order_id
| where isnull(resolve_time)
| join kind=leftouter techs on work_order_id
| lookup kind=leftouter TechnicianMaster on technician_id
| extend technician = coalesce(name, technician_id, "Unassigned")
| extend open_minutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), create_time)
| project work_order_id, device_id, machine_type, line_id, station_position,
    issue_type, technician, create_time, open_minutes
| order by open_minutes desc

let wo_created =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where action == "Created"
    | project work_order_id, create_time = timestamp, machine_type, line_id;
let wo_resolved =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where action == "Resolved"
    | project work_order_id, resolve_time = timestamp;
wo_created
| join kind=inner wo_resolved on work_order_id
| extend mttr_minutes = datetime_diff('minute', resolve_time, create_time)
| where mttr_minutes > 0
| summarize avg_mttr = round(avg(todouble(mttr_minutes)), 1), incidents = count()
    by machine_type, line_id
| join kind=leftouter StationMaster
    on $left.line_id == $right.line_id, $left.machine_type == $right.machine_type
| project machine_type, manufacturer, line_id, avg_mttr, incidents
| order by avg_mttr desc

MaintenanceEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where action == "Created"
| summarize fault_count = count() by issue_type, machine_type
| order by fault_count desc

MaintenanceEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    create_time  = minif(timestamp, action == "Created"),
    ack_time     = minif(timestamp, action == "Acknowledged"),
    start_time   = minif(timestamp, action == "InProgress"),
    resolve_time = minif(timestamp, action == "Resolved"),
    technician_id = any(technician_id)
    by work_order_id, device_id, machine_type, line_id, issue_type
| lookup kind=leftouter TechnicianMaster on technician_id
| extend technician = coalesce(name, technician_id)
| extend
    time_to_ack     = iif(isnotnull(ack_time), datetime_diff('minute', ack_time, create_time), int(null)),
    time_to_resolve = iif(isnotnull(resolve_time), datetime_diff('minute', resolve_time, create_time), int(null))
| project work_order_id, device_id, machine_type, line_id, issue_type, technician,
    create_time, time_to_ack, time_to_resolve
| order by create_time desc

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by machine_type, line_id
| invoke OeeKpis()
| project equipment = strcat(machine_type, " (", line_id, ")"), oee = round(coalesce(OEE, 0.0) * 100, 1)
| order by oee asc

PartEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where action in ("completed", "rejected")
| summarize
    total = count(),
    rejected = countif(action == "rejected")
    by line_id, station_position, machine_type
| extend reject_rate = round(todouble(rejected) / todouble(total) * 100, 2)
| top 20 by reject_rate desc

PartEvents
| where iif(isempty(_partId), timestamp > ago(5m), part_id == _partId)
| top 50 by timestamp desc
| project part_id, station_position, machine_type, action, cycle_time, quality_pass, timestamp
| order by part_id asc, station_position asc

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime, 5m)
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by timestamp = bucket_start, line_id
| invoke OeeKpis()
| where isnotnull(Quality)
| project timestamp, line_id, quality_pct = round(Quality * 100, 1)
| order by timestamp desc

let Window = 8h;
let WorkOrders = MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(Window) and action == "Created"
    | summarize work_orders = count_distinct(work_order_id) by shift = shift_id, line_id;
OeeFacts(ago(Window), now())
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by shift = shift_id, line_id
| invoke OeeKpis()
| join kind=leftouter WorkOrders on shift, line_id
| project shift, line_id, completed, rejected, quality = round(Quality, 4), oee = round(OEE, 4),
          work_orders = coalesce(work_orders, 0)
| order by line_id asc, shift asc

let Window = 8h;
let LastStation = LineMaster | project line_id, last_station = station_count;
let Finished = PartEvents
| where timestamp > ago(Window) and action == "completed"
| join kind=inner LastStation on line_id
| where station_position == last_station
| summarize finished_parts = count() by line_id, shift = shift_id;
let RunMinutes = MachineEvents
| where timestamp > ago(Window) and station_position == 1
| summarize minutes_run = count_distinct(bin(timestamp, 1m)) by line_id, shift = shift_id;
RunMinutes
| join kind=leftouter Finished on line_id, shift
| join kind=inner ProductionSchedule on line_id, shift
| join kind=inner (ShiftMaster | project shift, shift_minutes = ((end_hour - start_hour + 24) % 24) * 60) on shift
| extend finished_parts = coalesce(finished_parts, 0), expected_parts = planned_parts * minutes_run / todouble(shift_minutes)
| project line_id, shift, finished_parts, expected_parts = round(expected_parts, 0), planned_parts, adherence_pct = round(100.0 * finished_parts / expected_parts, 1)
| order by line_id asc, shift asc

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where machine_status == "Running"
| make-series avg_cycle = avg(actual_cycle_time) on timestamp from _startTime to _endTime step 1m by line_id
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(avg_cycle, 1.5)

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by line_id, station_position
| invoke OeeKpis()
| where isnotnull(Availability)
| project line_id, station = strcat("Stn-", station_position), availability_pct = round(Availability * 100, 1)
| order by line_id asc, station asc

MaintenanceEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where action == "Created"
| summarize fault_count = count() by line_id, machine_type, issue_type
| extend category = strcat(line_id, " / ", machine_type)
| project category, issue_type, fault_count
| order by fault_count desc

PartEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where line_id == _lineId
| summarize parts = dcount(part_id) by station_position
| order by station_position asc
| extend stage = strcat("Station ", station_position)
| project stage, parts

let K = OeeFacts(ago(5m), now(), 5m)
    | summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected)
    | invoke OeeKpis();
let finished = toscalar(PartPasses
    | where passed_at > ago(5m) and is_completed == 1
    | join kind=inner (LineMaster | project line_id, last_station = station_count) on line_id
    | where station_position == last_station
    | count);
let faulted = toscalar(MachineEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(5m)
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, machine_status) by device_id
    | where machine_status == "Fault"
    | count);
union
    (print metric = "Availability %", value = round(toscalar(K | project Availability) * 100, 1)),
    (print metric = "Quality %", value = round(toscalar(K | project Quality) * 100, 1)),
    (print metric = "Parts Finished", value = todouble(finished)),
    (print metric = "Machines in Fault", value = todouble(faulted))

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize Count = count() by machine_status

PartEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where action in ("completed", "rejected")
| summarize Completed = countif(action == "completed"), Rejected = countif(action == "rejected") by line_id
| order by line_id asc

let data = PartEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where action in ("completed", "rejected")
| summarize
    total_entered = count(),
    passed_qc = countif(action == "completed"),
    rejected = countif(action == "rejected");
data | project stage = "1 - Total Entered", value = total_entered
| union (data | project stage = "2 - Passed QC", value = passed_qc)
| union (data | project stage = "3 - Rejected", value = rejected)
| order by stage asc

let finished = toscalar(PartEvents | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) | where action == "completed" | lookup kind=inner (LineMaster | project line_id, station_count) on line_id | where station_position == station_count | count);
print Metric = "Parts finished", Value = finished

MachineEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where machine_status == "Running"
| summarize avg_cycle = round(avg(actual_cycle_time), 2) by bin(timestamp, 5m), line_id
| order by timestamp asc

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected)
| invoke OeeKpis()
| project Factory_OEE_pct = round(coalesce(OEE, 0.0) * 100, 1)

MaintenanceEvents
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where action == "Created"
| lookup kind=leftouter IssueTypeMaster on issue_type
| extend category = coalesce(category, "Uncategorized")
| summarize fault_count = count() by category
| order by fault_count desc

OeeFacts(_startTime, _endTime)
| lookup kind=leftouter MachineTypeMaster on machine_type
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by category = coalesce(category, "Other")
| invoke OeeKpis()
| project category, availability = round(coalesce(Availability, 0.0), 4), performance = round(coalesce(Performance, 0.0), 4),
          quality = round(coalesce(Quality, 0.0), 4), oee = round(coalesce(OEE, 0.0), 4)
| order by oee desc

let wos =
    MaintenanceEvents
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize create_time = minif(timestamp, action == "Created"),
        resolve_time = minif(timestamp, action == "Resolved"),
        technician_id = any(technician_id)
        by work_order_id
    | where isnotempty(technician_id);
wos
| lookup kind=leftouter TechnicianMaster on technician_id
| extend technician = coalesce(name, technician_id)
| extend resolve_minutes = iif(isnotnull(resolve_time), datetime_diff('minute', resolve_time, create_time), int(null))
| summarize total_wos = count(), open_wos = countif(isnull(resolve_time)), avg_resolve_min = round(avg(todouble(resolve_minutes)), 1) by technician
| order by total_wos desc

OeeFacts(ago(8h), now())
| summarize samples = sum(samples), running = sum(running), ideal = sum(ideal), actual = sum(actual), completed = sum(completed), rejected = sum(rejected) by shift = shift_id
| invoke OeeKpis()
| project shift, oee = round(coalesce(OEE, 0.0) * 100, 1)
| order by shift asc

tiles.title: OEE Components (A x P x Q)
